senses.gloss: m. (צפף; cmp. P. Sm. 3428 s. v. צף a. sq.) [coarse texture,]

units: <cite ref="Chullin 50b:10">Ḥull. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון … בצ׳ בדוחקא בלא צ׳ וכ׳</he> when three date-stones can pass the opening, by force with the covering on them, and easily without the covering.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:8">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>חזו הני צ׳ דבי רב וכ׳</he> look at the mats in the school house, some sleep thereon, while others are studying.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 8b">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ דבי וכ׳</he> the mats in the synagogue.—[<cite ref="Kiddushin 45a:6">Kidd. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>תותי צ׳</he> under mats spread over their heads, v. preced.]
<cite ref="Niddah 61a">Nidd. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>דגניין בצ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>במשולבות</he>) when the two women slept embracing each other.
